title: aspidium aculeatum
intro: Aspidium aculeatum, commonly known as the prickly fern or rough fern, is a type of plant species in the Polypodiaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its use as a diuretic to aid in the removal of excess fluids from the body. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium aculeatum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce swelling and prevent the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
